crossRefs.note: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

parallels.note: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
translations.bsb: All these are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and they were their chiefs.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
translations.asv: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs: the same is Edom.
